## What's Changed
* register: Say when the CI system's ID token endpoint, not the broker, is unreachable by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1353
* register: Mask the run token on Forgejo and refuse its debug switch by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1374
* policy: Admit plain-HTTP clone URLs for hosts the bounds name by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1375
* collect: Validate and sanitize safe outputs in Rust for callers off GitHub by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1384
* run: Front the broker with run's own proxy, so the agent never holds the run token by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1395
* ci: Avoid queue failures from lagging job timestamps by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1401
* apply: Publish a checked hand-back to Forgejo by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1373
* session: Avoid competing for released test ports by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1407
* policy: Hold runs off GitHub to a neutral safe-output profile by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1408
* check: Let the bounds add protected paths as globs by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1421
* egress: Pin the runner's storage writes to the results service's accounts by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1422
* apply: Avoid loopback workarounds for bounds-approved HTTP forges by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1428
* ci: Fail the scratch cleanup only on a real leak, not on a transient API error by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1442
* docs: Drop the deleted sandbox/exec.rs from layout.md by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1447
* docs: Name the code owner for the merge policy and say who must add CODEOWNERS by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1448
* review: Check dependency manifest and lockfile changes as supply chain by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1451
* policy: Apply the per-output pins to add_reviewer and assign_to_user too by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1465
* apply: Keep carriage returns when the Forgejo publisher applies a patch by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1466
* sandbox: Refuse the sandbox user the IPv6 metadata address unconditionally by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1467
* apply: Escape what the handlers log, so the agent's patch cannot form a workflow command by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1482
* inference: Cut the key out of a provider's whole answer before shortening it by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1483
* policy: Refuse GitHub by host name, not by whole authority by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1481
* run: Redact the reason a change was dropped before it is shown by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1480
* workflows check: Admit a deploy-only Pages job without secure-host by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1526
* run: Drop a hand-back whose requests file is not taken, and say so by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1484
* docs: Publish the docs as a Starlight site on GitHub Pages by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1450
* site: Give the docs site a landing page that explains agentic-job at a glance by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1540
* docs, dispatch: Say the reusable workflow refuses keys, MCP, private targets and setup.tools; refuse api-key in dispatch preflig by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1553
* docs: Describe the runner-user agent the reusable workflow actually runs by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1554
* handback: Refuse a new run token in the in-session scan by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1556
* run: Refuse [child-agent] under --runner-home by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1555
* docs: Start every generated document with the LLM notice by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1563
* workflow: Say that activate, notify, apply and conclude hold id-token by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1574
* workflows check: Advise only the hardening input the checker admits, and make the caller example pass it by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1575
* run: Make run's token probes the only ones, with the documented ids by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1580
* docs: Describe secure-host's lock and metadata rule as config keys, not removed inputs by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1573
* site: Show the LLM notice as a page banner instead of a body blockquote by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1605
* status: Let the caller name the comment the run's status goes in by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1624
* docs: Bring the gh-aw comparison up to date, gh-cao included by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1635
* config: Read the example and verifier repository from configuration, not code by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1633
* secure-host: Pin the forwarder and site.yml to actions with the v0.6.3 image by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1626
* agent job: Let a caller opt the agent into the egress write policy by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1634
* config: Turn on the runner's metadata, reads and Worker-diagnostics rules by default under the lock by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1632
* sandbox setup: Keep the sandbox user by default, opt out with sandbox.create-user = false by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1724
* docs: Leave the host's hardening to secure-host's docs and keep only the agent's use by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1730
* run: Make the runner's user the default agent user, with the sandbox user one input away by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1729
* secure-host: Refuse the removed sandbox-user input again by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1754
* secure-host: Start the crate with the host setup that needs no agent by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1753
* ci: Bump actions/deploy-pages to 5.0.1 by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1764
* release: Prepare 0.6.4 by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1775
* run: Run the agent's confinement tests as the runner's user by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1776
* policy: Reserve bounds for a secondary pull request, refused until enforced by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1798
* policy: Carry a secondary pull request through run, hand-back and check by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1803


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/compare/v0.6.3...v0.6.4
